# TH3RD GROUP — service and entity reference

## Company

TH3RD GROUP LLC is a strategy, technology and execution company serving consumer brands and growing businesses. The company works in English and Spanish. Its role is to organize commercial direction, operating systems and coordinated delivery so teams can move from opportunity to measurable execution.

Website: https://th3rdgroup.com/
Spanish: https://th3rdgroup.com/es/
Contact: hello@th3rdgroup.com

## U.S. market entry consulting

TH3RD GROUP helps consumer and CPG brands prepare to sell in the United States. Work can include market and category framing, customer and geographic priorities, channel strategy, marketplace and retail pathways, operating readiness, launch planning, decision gates and cross-functional coordination. Engagements can begin with a market-entry assessment, a launch-planning sprint or fractional execution leadership.

English: https://th3rdgroup.com/solutions/us-market-entry/
Español: https://th3rdgroup.com/es/soluciones/entrada-mercado-estados-unidos/

## Ecommerce operations consulting

TH3RD GROUP helps brands design and operate ecommerce channels across Amazon, Walmart.com Marketplace, TikTok Shop, Mercado Libre, Shopify and direct-to-consumer models. Work can connect channel roles, catalog and content, inventory, campaigns, customer signals, reporting, workflows, automation, ownership and decision cadences. Engagements can begin with a channel operations audit, an ecommerce operations sprint or fractional channel leadership.

English: https://th3rdgroup.com/solutions/ecommerce-operations/
Español: https://th3rdgroup.com/es/soluciones/operaciones-ecommerce/

## Market readiness assessment

TH3RD GROUP provides a preliminary, source-backed review of product context, labels, documentation and channel questions before a brand enters a target country or growth channel. The Country Readiness Report separates evidence, observations, open questions, priorities and areas that may require qualified specialist review. It is not a legal opinion, official approval, certification or guaranteed compliance determination.

English: https://th3rdgroup.com/solutions/market-readiness/
Español: https://th3rdgroup.com/es/soluciones/preparacion-mercado/

## AI consulting and business automation

TH3RD GROUP helps companies identify, build and adopt practical AI and automation systems around defined workflows, decisions and customer outcomes. Work can include workflow diagnosis, use-case prioritization, process redesign, integrations, conventional automation, AI-assisted capabilities, human review, permissions, governance, training and measurement. TH3RD GROUP does not recommend AI when a simpler and more dependable process or automation is the better answer.

English: https://th3rdgroup.com/solutions/ai-transformation/
Español: https://th3rdgroup.com/es/soluciones/transformacion-ia/

## Decision resources

## Commercial and professional boundaries

TH3RD GROUP does not claim to represent Amazon, Walmart or other retailers and does not guarantee placement, distribution or commercial outcomes. Market-readiness services are preliminary advisory work and do not replace qualified legal, regulatory, laboratory or certification professionals. Specialized support may be required depending on the product, market, channel and risk profile.
